summary: This PR cleanly introduces a shared device-WS contract-fixture suite under tests/contract/device-ws/ (13 fixtures + index.json manifest + lint.js) and rewires all three consumers (backend devices-ws.test.ts, agent/lib.test.js, agent-tauri protocol.rs) to decode/encode those shared files, deleting the duplicated per-implementation cases per AGENTS.md §6. The fixtures cover every frame type in the protocol: hello, heartbeat, capabilities, all five command envelopes (run_web, install_apk, build_android, run_desktop, run_ios), all three command_result variants (running/done/failed), welcome, and close-4001. Each fixture includes a descriptive _comment and a direction tag. The lint script validates structure, manifest-to-disk consistency, and consumer wiring (backend + agent reference index.json; Tauri include_str!'s every fixture). CI is updated to run the lint in the always-on backend job and to trigger the agent and agent-tauri jobs on fixture-only changes. I verified all 79 Node-agent tests pass, all 1082 backend tests pass (13 in devices-ws.test.ts), and the lint passes; the Rust test module is correct by inspection (no C linker in this environment, but the Tauri CI job compiles it). The capabilities.rs structs correctly gain Deserialize to support the fixture round-trip, and protocol.rs actually shrinks slightly (408→398 lines). The directive's mention of run_tests is a future dependency — the command does not exist anywhere in the codebase yet — so its omission is correct. This is a correct, minimal, and safe change.
